note: Triennial election of Castlereagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Six of the nine seats were contested. Of the six sitting official Unionists who faced contests only three held their seats: Castlereagh went to Labour, Ballyhackamore to the Tenants' Association and Ballycultra to an unofficial Unionist. Printed: 'No change.'
